text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Valentine's Day.
Gather the sounds of love on this day, let them flow, and set them solid.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Don't you think doing so will give birth
to a melody as dolce as chocolate?"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...And so, let's go, amore! In search of the "sound of love"!
choice_data_list: ...What do you mean by 'the sound of love'?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... That, you see,
is the sweet melody that naturally rings out
when one person holds another in their heart!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I'd love nothing more than to seek out those sounds with you.
...What do you say? Will you join me?
choice_data_list: (Out of nowhere again... but still.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's burning with creative passion
and is practically begging me to join in.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They must believe having me around will help the creative process.
In that case—
choice_data_list: Let's go search for the sound of love!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, my search for the "Sound of Love"
with Sounds of Earth began—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
For instance... look.
Take a look over there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Looking in the direction pointed out, I saw a pair walking side by side in sync. They occasionally exchanged words, only to look away... It was an agonizingly awkward sight.
choice_data_list: Are they a couple, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...No, just a little more.
They're still hiding it from each other for now...!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
This desire to hold hands!
This passionate urge to give an abbraccio!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I'm going!
I'll fire both of them up with my melody!
choice_data_list: Juuuust a moment...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If she charges in like this, she'll only end up causing confusion.
Still, I truly want her to hear the sound of love."
choice_data_list: Isn't there some way to stick it back naturally...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking over, I saw the woman of the couple
taking out her smartphone. She was looking towards the photo spot,
but seemed hesitant to ask her boyfriend.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...This is it.
Taking photos. Let's make use of this!"
choice_data_list: Um, shall I take a photo for you?

text_block_list.name: Girlfriend
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah... A-Are you sure?
Ah, oh, but...

text_block_list.name: Boyfriend
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, please!
I really wanted a commemorative photo too...!
choice_data_list: Line up, then, please! Squeeze in closer~!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! What a wonderful assist!
Amore, you're an angelo...!
choice_data_list: Did you hear it!? The "Sound of Love"...!
Did you hear that!? The "Sound of Love"...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Kh, but of course...!
Let's keep collecting 'sounds' at this rate!
choice_data_list: (I'll make sure it doesn't get out of hand and bridge it smoothly!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Hello, signorina.
Would you mind telling me, if it's all right?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —About the innocent "love" you harbor.

text_block_list.name: Child Buying Sweets
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wh-What!? WHAAAAT!?
choice_data_list: I'm sorry, I just want to compose music...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Look over there.
He's watching for the right timing to propose!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Now that it's come to this—
choice_data_list: I'll go ask if we can use the shop's piano!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As long as we get permission...!
With her skills, it should naturally liven up
the atmosphere as in-store BGM...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, accompanying Sounds of Earth,
the day passed by...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Phew, we gathered so much.
With all this, I can write a Valentine's song full of con amore!
choice_data_list: Thank goodness...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as relief set in, a sudden gust of wind blew,
sweeping the memo away.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Aah, what a mischievous wind...!
choice_data_list: Oh no, my important notes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In a rush, I gather up the scattered notes.
Just as I squared the edges of what I'd collected—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The contents of the memo caught my eye.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: "You wish to hear the music I compose... That pure, unadulterated tremor of passion—benissimo!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"And for that very sake, the passion that does not hesitate to play the incarnation of love itself!
What else could this be called if not love!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: "To re-convey my passion with such warmth, without distorting it—that kindness was, above all else, breathtakingly beautiful. Che bello!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"The gesture of matching her gaze, born of that deep affection...
Though personally, I'd prefer those benevolent eyes be turned only toward me."
choice_data_list: (Hmh??)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Strong, yet gentle.
Your heart that wavers for the sake of others is energico e calmando—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Above all, your fervent trust in my music.
Not out of duty, but because
your sheer 'sincerity' makes my soul tremble."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: "In other words, it is the sound of love—resonating from within yourself."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...Did you end up seeing that?
choice_data_list: ...Um, aren't those the notes of sounds you've been collecting...?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: That's right, I wrote down the sounds that resonated in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Slowly, taking a step forward.
A face bearing an elegant smile draws near.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: The sound of passionate, devoted love that I yearned for.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: It had been echoing right by my side the entire time.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for telling me, amore.
choice_data_list: There's just no beating Earth, huh...
G-Glad I could be of help...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: "Oh! What delightful news!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
In other words—that last one really "hit home."
...Heheh, I'll remember that.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu! Grazie!
Consider it my thanks for making my heart
race today... or something like that, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Are you blushing? That voice of yours has such an utterly charming vibrato.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for letting me hear your racing heartbeat.
—My little kitten.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for letting me hear your racing heartbeat.
—My little kitten.
